caption: The drawing depicts a decorative border or frieze with ornate detailing. The upper portion features a repeating pattern of stylized foliage shapes in yellow-gold with blue accents, set against a backdrop with a reddish outline separating this section from the rest of the composition. Below this, there are draped swags colored in white with light blue floral and vine motifs, edged in gold and red, and interspersed with gold fringe. Large, gold tassels hang at the center and sides of the swags. Between the swags, there are dark green garlands or bunches filled with blue flowers and green leaves, bordered by yellow-gold fabric with green vertical stripes and red outlining. At the intersections of the swags and the garlands, there are pink ornamental rosettes or knots. The entire image is set against a plain cream or off-white background, with the composition densely detailed and richly colored in shades of gold, blue, green, red, white, and pink. The drawing is signed "Frances Lichten" in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Paper Border Design
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
